chars.text: Same causes as commands.lines — the contract fields are prose-heavy by design (a falsifiable exit criterion costs a sentence, not a token), so chars grew far harder than lines. Raised 2026-08-11 during Phase 10 UAT execution: commands/research.md's first exit_criteria entry was the only one of 94 ending in a bare 'exists', which .writ/docs/component-contract.md:84 explicitly bans; it gained a predicate naming the scoped questions and synthesis (+88 chars).

note: Down is free. An increase to a gated surface is silent only up to a recorded ceiling: set surfaces.<name>.justifications.<lines|chars> to {"value": <measurement>, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "text": "<why>"}. It silences growth to that value and nothing beyond it. Rerunning --update-baseline instead moves EVERY surface's floor to its current measurement and records no reason.
